entries.0904c7387fd825a7: This is a main business that manufactures and sells rolls for steel rolling, molds for steel ingots, casting molds for automobiles, dense bars (continuous cast iron bars), general castings, aluminum alloy cast products, and other products. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥22,700,006,000 plus ¥7,000,000. Subsidiary Oguchi Alloy Casting Co., Ltd. handles aluminum alloy cast products, and Tianjin Kogi Cast Steel Co., Ltd. and Nantong Kogi Cast Steel Co., Ltd. in China handle casting molds for automobile presses.
entries.1d23f0ee4b10a361: The company is a casting manufacturer headquartered in Himeji, Hyogo Prefecture, and forms a group with four consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.373d8fe542a1f1c1: A foundry manufacturer in Himeji that focuses on castings such as steel rolling rolls and automotive mold castings, and also handles environmental equipment and friction materials.
entries.3d57c8934ef34cf4: This is a business that manufactures and sells friction materials and other products for automobiles, railways, and industrial machinery. It handles friction materials and refractory materials using the metal short fiber "KC Metal Fiber." Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥800,003,000 plus ¥5,000,000.
entries.694915450054c4d2: A business in which the consolidated subsidiary KOGI Service Co., Ltd. carries out security and other operations for the company's Himeji East Plant and Himeji West Plant; it is not included in the reportable segments.
entries.823660417478b6b8: The company is a casting manufacturer headquartered in Himeji, Hyogo Prefecture, and forms a group with four consolidated subsidiaries. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 766, and the company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.89acfa05357d05bc: The main business, which manufactures and sells steel rolling rolls, ingot molds, automotive die castings, dense bars (continuously cast iron bars), general castings, aluminum alloy cast products and more.
entries.8d926a44bd97a597: A business that manufactures and sells friction materials and other products for automobiles, railways and industrial machinery.
entries.bc4e44fe6f56959f: A business that manufactures and sells environment-related equipment and machinery products, undertakes civil engineering and construction work, and sells solar power.
entries.dcd52fe01f010b32: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary Kogi Service Co., Ltd. performs security and other work for the company's Himeji East Plant and Himeji West Plant, and it is not included in the reporting segments. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,000 plus ¥8,000,000.
entries.e6da43034921f5a8: This is a business that manufactures and sells environment-related equipment and machinery products, undertakes civil engineering and construction work, and sells solar power. It handles equipment and blowers for municipal waste incineration plants and energy-saving products such as Transvectors. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,000,005,000 plus ¥6,000,000.
